Q4-25._note: Q4-25 diluted EPS ($10.23) is on the if-converted basis for the 6.00% mandatory convertible preferred: numerator = net earnings attributable to Boeing (preferred dividends of $86m added back), denominator 803.8m incl. conversion shares (Q4-25 release).

Q4-25._src: FY2025 10-K Note 2 (preliminary allocation): cash 281; receivables 339 + unbilled 126 + inventories 1,438; PP&E 2,419; goodwill 9,997; intangibles 109; other assets 116 + other 166; payables 953 + accrued 1,784 (incl. $1,065 off-market contracts) + advances 97; debt 329 + 3,279; other LT liabilities 178; consideration 8,371 (Boeing shares 4,704; settled loans / advances 2,571; debt repaid 948; Exchangeable Notes premium 109; awards 39).

guidance_2026._status: UNVERIFIED: earnings-call statements reported by third-party transcripts / summaries; Boeing has published no numeric outlook in its 8-K releases since 2019.
guidance_2026.fcf_src: Q4-25 call (27-Jan-2026); reaffirmed on the Q2-26 call (28-Jul-2026), incl. ~$1bn unfavourable Spirit impact and a ~$700m DOJ payment in Q3-26.
guidance_2026.del_737_src: Q4-25 call: ~500 737 deliveries in 2026; Q2-26 call: on track.
guidance_2026.bds_src: Q2-26 call: ~2.5% for 2026 incl. the $280m VC-25B charge (Q1-26 call: ~3.5%).
guidance_2026.bca_margin: negative in 2026 (Spirit integration), positive in 2027 (conference summary)

edgar_facts.mcps: 6.00% Series A mandatory convertible preferred, 5,750,000 shares, $5,750m liquidation preference; converts ~15-Oct-2027 into 5.8280–6.9940 common shares per share (FY2025 10-K, risk factors / Note).
edgar_facts.debt: Total debt $54.1bn at 31-Dec-2025 (10-K); $45.9bn at 30-Jun-2026, $4.6bn short-term; cash $7.2bn, short-term investments $12.8bn; $10.0bn unused revolvers (Q2-26 10-Q).

maturities._src: FY2025 10-K debt note (debt and other notes; finance leases separately $250m).

amort_sched._src: FY2025 10-K Note 4 (estimated amortization of acquired finite-lived intangibles).

edgar_facts.das: Digital Aviation Solutions divestiture closed 31-Oct-2025 for $10.55bn cash; pre-tax gain $9.6bn (Q4-25 release).
edgar_facts.spirit: Spirit AeroSystems acquisition closed 8-Dec-2025; 22.98m Boeing shares issued (0.1955 exchange ratio); goodwill to BCA (10-K Note 2).
edgar_facts.rates: 737 production 42/month (Q4-25 release) → transitioning to 47/month (Q2-26 release; North Line LRIP July-2026); 787 transitioning to 8/month (Q4-25 release); 737-7 / -10 certification expected 2026, first deliveries 2027 (Q2-26 release).
